title: Linear Estimation of Aggregate Dynamic Discrete Demand for Durable Goods: Overcoming the Curse of Dimensionality
authors: Cheng Chou; Timothy P. Derdenger; Vineet Kumar
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Methodological paper: linear estimator for aggregate dynamic discrete demand for durable goods (mobile phones), applied to brand-market-month shares; no binary treatment with adoption dates.
design_notes: CDK_Code/estimation_v32_simulateddata.R: multi-step linear estimation (lm(ybw ~ productFactor - 1), lm(y_step5 ~ 1), lm(y_phi ~ 1)) with HAC variance; brand x state x month market shares and product characteristics.
data_files_note: Only a simulated dataset is shipped (NDA).
data_provenance_note: README: 'this data is a simulated version that is generated rather than real data due to non-disclosure requirements.'
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
